lines.text: One kilo short on fifty is two percent of your money.
lines.phonemes: wˈʌn kˈiːloʊ ʃˈɔːɹt ˌɔn fˈɪfti ɪz tˈuː pɚsˈɛnt ʌv jʊɹ mˈʌni.

lines.text: By law, a scale used in trade must be verified and stamped.
lines.phonemes: baɪ lˈɔː, ɐ skˈeɪl jˈuːzd ɪn tɹˈeɪd mˈʌst biː vˈɛɹᵻfˌaɪd ænd stˈæmpt.

lines.text: Check the stamp's year, the certificate, and the verified test weights traders must keep.
lines.phonemes: tʃˈɛk ðə stˈæmps jˈɪɹ, ðə sɚtˈɪfɪkət, ænd ðə vˈɛɹᵻfˌaɪd tˈɛst wˈeɪts tɹˈeɪdɚz mˈʌst kˈiːp.

lines.text: Say 500 kilos sell for ₹15,000; after buying and transport, ₹900 is left.
lines.tts: Say five hundred kilos sell for fifteen thousand rupees; after buying and transport, nine hundred is left.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ fˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd kˈiːloʊz sˈɛl fɔːɹ fˈɪftiːn θˈaʊzənd ɹˈuːpiːz; ˈæftɚ bˈaɪɪŋ ænd tɹˈænspɔːɹt, nˈaɪn hˈʌndɹɪd ɪz lˈɛft.

lines.text: A 2% light scale takes ₹300 of that.
lines.tts: A two percent light scale takes three hundred of that.
lines.phonemes: ɐ tˈuː pɚsˈɛnt lˈaɪt skˈeɪl tˈeɪks θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd ʌv ðˈæt.

lines.text: Check the scale before you check the price.
lines.phonemes: tʃˈɛk ðə skˈeɪl bᵻfˌɔːɹ juː tʃˈɛk ðə pɹˈaɪs.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
